scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run db:generate && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d --wait db && npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:test:up: docker compose --profile test up -d --wait db-test && npm run db:migrate:test
